stage: Exploratory matched reanalysis; written after source and full-cohort convergence diagnostics, before these resampling fits
primary_target: The converged binary-logit projection of the fixed1200-row AI-aligned human cohort. All methods are evaluated against the same target.
source_units: 240 contiguous five-row blocks, following the source script. The released numeric file does not independently certify respondent identities.
allocation_rule: One permutation of the240 blocks per trial. Human label budgets50,100,150,200 use nested prefixes; every remaining row is auxiliary. This fixed-target scheme differs explicitly from the source's changing prefix-pool convention.
methods: clipped-target AI self-training as in the released code
nuisance_models: Match the released C=0.05 ridge logistic convention and five row folds. AI version fits separate models within discrete AI-label strata. X-only version uses the same folds and regularization without AI strata. No tuning on target errors. Row cross-fitting is recorded as a source convention, not independent-person validation.
clipping_identity: For a labelled one-hot outcome and0<e<1, clipping every component of g+(y-g)/e to[0,1] and renormalizing returns y exactly. Unlabelled rows retain g. Verify numerically in every allocation.
existence_checks: Use the classical binary exponential-family mean-support LP before fitting corrected losses. Retain infeasible, boundary/near-boundary and unresolved solver cases; no hidden bounds or silent clipping in corrected methods.
outcomes: parameter error to all three explicitly named references
conditional paired comparisons on shared finite cases, alongside full failure counts
limits: This is a controlled reanalysis, not an exact reproduction of the article's tables. It does not evaluate embeddings or PPI++ and cannot establish a full-method ranking. Resampling allocations add no human participants. No confidence-interval validity claim is made in this stage.
stopping_rule: Complete all500 allocations at all four budgets and retain all methods. Report effects that remain after fixing target and optimization; do not infer disappearance of AI value before observing results.
